notes.title: Update 0.24.0 is available !
notes.notes:
[h2]The new update for[i] Vestiges: Fallen Tribes[/i] is here! Our team has been hard at work to bring you new content, improvements, and quality-of-life changes that will enhance your gameplay experience. Early Access means constant evolution, and we’re committed to making the game the best it can be.[/h2]

[h1]What’s the biggest change?[/h1]
One of the key focuses of this Early Access is enhancing the solo campaign. We’re expanding the solo campaign to provide a longer-lasting experience with a dynamic progression system. This means more challenges to overcome, and an engaging narrative that immerses you in the world of the game.

By expanding the solo campaign, we’re ensuring that [i]Vestiges: Fallen Tribes[/i] isn’t solely reliant on multiplayer. This gives you the freedom to enjoy a rich, solo experience at your own pace while also allowing you to sharpen your skills for competitive play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/7b3bd8bfe53b4b038f2fbad7ea65999679d8b9bf.png[/img]

[h1]Introducing a New Tribe[/h1]
This major update also brings a brand-new tribe to the battlefield! The [i]Amonsets[/i] introduces unique gameplay mechanics that not only diversify your strategic options but also shake up the multiplayer meta.

With a different playstyle and new abilities, this tribe will challenge you guys to rethink your strategies and adapt to new dynamics, keeping the multiplayer experience fresh and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/4a1afe160bca3bfe9b6c3cf3f813febd807845c8.png[/img]

[h1]Immersive VR Enhancements[/h1]
If you’re exploring the game in VR, get ready for an even more immersive experience! This update includes several VR-specific enhancements such as parallax effect on cards’ artworks, making every game feel more intense and engaging. You can also pick up and inspect figurines in the environment around you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/b3ed4ac9f6d29567a4911da8ee12de8bfb24fc69.png[/img]

[h3]As we continue to develop [i]Vestiges: Fallen Tribes[/i], your feedback remains crucial. Early Access allows us to work closely with our community to shape the future of the game. Make sure to join us in multiplayer tomorrow friday 21st at 3PM CET to play against the dev and to give us your feedback on this new version of the game ! Or you can join us on Discord to discuss this new content.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/f1577aafcebe88ba7173e22ea9d92440ba1481ae.png[/img]


___________________________________________________________________
[h1]⬇️⬇️Full patchnote ⬇️⬇️[/h1]


[h1]🆕 New Feature[/h1]
[b]New Tribe: Amonsets[/b]
[list][*] 8 new units
[*] New mechanic: When dying, Amonset figurines leave Remains that can be revived by the High Priestess
[*] New mechanic: Ephemeral units return to your hand on the next turn[/list]
[b]New Adrarii Unit: Battering Ram[/b]
[list][*] A slow but resilient machine that can withstand heavy damage
[*] Brings the Adrarii tribe to 8 total units, like the others[/list]
[b]Completely New Solo Missions[/b]
[list][*] 4 out of 9 missions are available now, with more to come!
[*] Secondary objectives added to increase difficulty and replayability[/list]
[b]New Tactical Tutorials (Tactics Mode)[/b]
[list][*] Learn key game mechanics through 8 tutorial challenges
[*] Failing a solo mission? The game will now suggest a related tactic to help you master the mechanics[/list]
[b]New Sandbox Mode [i](Not available in VR yet)[/i][/b]
[list][*] Choose two factions
[*] Deploy any number of any units on each side (no cards, no energy)
[*] Observe Resolution phase
[*] Add, move, or remove any unit at will and repeat for testing[/list]
[b]Battlefield Updates[/b]
[list][*] New battlefields: Dahrii Valley & Forsaken Land
[*] Tissara Bridges (formerly Three Bridges) redesigned
[*] Water Wells is being redesigned and temporarily unavailable[/list]
[b]New Dissolve Effect[/b]
[list][*] Units now have a smoother appearance/disappearance effect on the battlefield[/list]
[b]New VR Features[/b]
[list][*] Parallax effect on card artworks for added depth
[*] Figurines in the environment can now be picked up and inspected
[*] Throw a dice on the board to deploy
[*] Tilt the board using joysticks for more comfort[/list]

[h1]⚙️ Improvements[/h1]
[b]Game Scale Adjustments[/b]
[list][*] Fewer figurines per unit for better readability and balance
[*] Increased board and figurine size, adjusted movement speed accordingly
[*] As a result, old missions and weekly challenges have been removed[/list]
[b]Main Menu Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Clearer navigation between Solo and Multiplayer sessions[/list]
[b]Unit Management Fixes[/b]
[list] [*] Smoother transitions between Preparation and Resolution phases[/list]
[b]VFX Enhancements[/b]
[list][*] New effect when the Protector’s shield breaks
[*] New camouflage material for the Shadow Blades
[*] Sandstorms now fade out naturally at board edges
[*] Improved sync between Arwhii’s jump animation and VFX[/list]

[*] [b]Deck selection[/b] for Practice Mode (including Custom Decks)[/list]

Lead 3d Artist Johann Gerard spent some time making this amazing animation from modeling the elements from Suzanne's concepts to animating them. “[i]At each stage, I had to think about how to do things, and that's what was enjoyable to do. Additionally, this exercise combined a variety of techniques: using multiple UVs for texturing, scripting, and utilizing shape keys (morph targets)[/i].”

For example, there are around a hundred pieces in the animated board. Manually placing one bone on each piece (which allows it to move) would have taken me a lot of time. So, to speed up the process, Johann wrote a script that does it in just one click inside Blender.

notes.title: Devlog#4 - Let's talk about the next update
notes.notes:
[h3]For this 4th devlog, we should have been talking about a very dense subject that is the cards design. But as I was writing this article, the team’s process and goals changed and my information became in a way obsolete but that’s okay. We have lots of other cool stuff coming to Vestiges: Fallen Tribes’ next update 0.9.0. Let’s talk about some of them! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/76d32b7fd5f220d43eef5354fe090e25e7661601.png[/img]

[b]Make room for the newest unit: the Gorgon[/b]
As we said in our Devlog #3 about the Cura, adding new units inject novelty into gameplay, stimulates strategic innovation, and fosters ongoing excitement as players explore fresh possibilities. We’re obviously committed to maintaining your interest and engagement over time as we’re working on one of the most expected features: deckbuilding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/7ecf4c9c3ccd56d619047d6b1967e19b553625a4.jpg[/img]

The Gorgon is a powerful new Adrarii unit that petrifies the closest opponent’s unit with flying drones located at the end of its hair. The whole opposite unit - whether it’s a group or a single figurine - is then immobilized for a couple of seconds and can be killed by just one strike. [i]“Basically the Gorgon and a Sandstormer can stun an entire group of gladiators and instantaneously kill them”[/i], Pierre Heinisch Game Designer explains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/639c41644f8f45927540c9c61e738285a763a1c4.jpg[/img]

The Adrarii tribe was inspired by Berbers people and mountain tribes from North Africa and the Middle east. In Libyan mythology, the origins of the Gorgon, often associated with the monstrous Medusa, are shrouded in ancient lore. [i]“It is said that the Gorgon's roots trace back to the desolate expanses of Libya, where tales of her dreadful gaze and serpentine locks echo through time”[/i], Pierre adds. 

Some myths suggest that the Gorgon was born from the union of ancient sea deities in the region's tumultuous waters, while others attribute her creation to the wrath of the gods. Regardless of her origins, the Gorgon's presence in Libyan mythology serves as a potent symbol of power, fear, and the enigmatic forces that govern the natural world.[i] “From this background, the concept was pretty quick to draw. We added our little tech twist with the flying drones and it was ready”[/i], Suzane Rault precises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/f1cbe5253c342a51985b434d4d9df7f7815ad8f5.gif[/img]

Integrating the unit was pretty simple using the original system Pierre created. But the hair animation went a little crazy sometimes. [i]“We used Unreal Engine's particle system Niagara to create the cables, and we animated them procedurally using… Math. But since we suck at math”[/i], Pierre jokes.

We can’t wait to see what you think of this new unit and what strategy you’ll use its ability!

[b]A brand new environment[/b]
The big thing coming up in this next update is a pretty consequent visual change for the players. Indeed, you’re gonna be able to dive into a brand new player’s environment. On PC and in VR, you’ll be surrounded by a very detailed scene. The point of this very important “glow up” is to insert environmental narration and be able to tell a story through those elements.

[i]“An immersive player environment is essential as it transports players into richly crafted worlds, fostering deeper engagement, emotional connection, and memorable experiences that transcend the boundaries of the game itself”[/i], Suzanne explains. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/d3b15bc44f9650fd7eec49b2eacbdccda068c9aa.jpg[/img]
[i]Before Cécile's work[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/5dc6625eed56161370311921fcbf73ddc7ea7352.jpg[/img]
[i]After[/i]

Cecile Chevanne, 3D artist, created the scene in Unreal Engine using Suzanne's indications about the universe, the type of objects found there, and the atmosphere she wants to create. [i]“Suzanne wanted to create an intimate atmosphere for the room, resembling a tribal sci-fi shelter. Roughly like a billiard room in a bar. Structurally, she wanted the building to be constructed on ancient ruins with futuristic elements”[/i], Cécile presents. 

Cécile then built the environment assembling elements like Legos. After placing the ground and mountains, she designed multiple room shapes until achieving a satisfactory result. [i]“I created ruins/stones and incorporated wooden/metal elements as well as walls. The small furniture pieces, a blend of wood and metal, were then arranged around”[/i], Cécile adds. 

Outside, she followed the same principle by adding futuristic houses to the ruins and arranged small spaces dedicated to a bar, reading, and figurine painting, suggesting a creative atmosphere.[i] “Finally, to bring life to the room, I added hangings, lanterns, tableware, and other objects. For lighting, I favored an exterior view with the noon sun while maintaining an intimate atmosphere inside with lanterns and a spotlight directed toward the game board, the central element of the room.”[/i]

[b]Brand new set of hands (VR only)[/b]
We mentioned it a while back, but new hands will finally be available In VR. The idea was to bring another dimension to the player’s experience and immerse them even more. Personifying the player by giving them hands that fit the environment was one of the challenges the creative team had to deal with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/83117a99ccf56b4e6294db1f5e04aaeeb105ed20.png[/img]


[i]“The player's hand in a VR game is of paramount importance as it serves as their primary means of interaction with the virtual environment, bridging the gap between the physical and digital worlds”[/i], Pierre says. The hands are another important element of the story we want to convey inside the game, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716226/d5ffe173d46ff0fbe8292aaabc91473beb292769.png[/img]

[b]About the cards’ designs [/b]
Although this subject is still in development, I can tell you that the card's design is essential, as it not only influences the aesthetic appeal but also contributes significantly to gameplay clarity, ensuring smooth comprehension and strategic engagement for players of all levels. 

We won’t get into the details of this but you’ll see small changes in the cards, we want to make them more readable and distinct from each other. But we know it’s not there yet so please keep that in mind. 

We will definitely talk about it in details in a next devlog !
